WAR (possibly short for Warcraft Archive) is the custom archive format used for Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and its expansion. However, the format was very simple and third-party tools were eventually made to open these files. The MPQ format was created as a replacement and first used with the release of Diablo and made its way to future game releases. Despite this format being used for Warcraft II, the Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition release uses the MPQ format.

Vyranoth the Frozenheart is one of the four Primal Incarnates. Along with her brethren, she rejected the gift of the titans and turned to the elements instead, becoming an incarnation of frost. However, after being freed from imprisonment and realizing that the Primal Incarnates' goals are not as noble as she once believed, Vyranoth defected to siding with Azeroth's defenders, reconciling with her old friend Alexstrasza, the Life-Binder.

The Wailing Caverns is in the Northern Barrens, to the south of Crossroads, on the north side of the Lushwater Oasis. The Wailing Caverns is one of the first instanced dungeons that lower-level Horde players encounter. One primary reason to venture into the Wailing Caverns is for BoP drops from the numerous bosses in the instance. Some of the quest rewards are also highly desirable. Even the poor quality drops are better than ordinary; a stack of typical trash drops is worth around five to ten silver.

WTB is an acronym for Want To Buy. This can also be used in a mocking or subtle way of asking for something such as a buff, item, class, etc. Example: "WTB Sunders" means whomever is the Warrior should use Sunder Armor.

Acronym for "Want To Trade". Indicating that the player wants a certain item or service in exchange for another item or service, as opposed to money. In recent months, this term is often used by people who desire to trade accounts; However, such offer are often scam. In addition, it is against the Terms of Service of World of Warcraft. See also WTB and WTS.

WTF, an acronym for Warcraft Text File, is a Blizzard file extension. The most notable of this type are config.wtf and realmlist.wtf. It is also the name of a subdirectory of the World of Warcraft directory which contains these types of files. It is also shorthand for what the f*** or who the f***, used to show surprise, displeasure, and/or outrage at a person or circumstance.

Wallace Boltscrew is one of the four commodores of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and has been under Duke Falrevere's service for many years even before the duke became a pirate lord. Wallace was a valuable high-ranking member of Falrevere's household in Kul Tiras before the Third War; he created devices to assist in all manner of situations and was the head of the other servants. He was head butler (he still wears his butler suit), head chef and stablemaster. Once he started constructing devices of war, though, he found his calling. WDB files (Warcraft DataBase files, or .wdb) are files created by World of Warcraft to cache data retrieved from its game servers. WDB files regroup data downloaded in chunks. The data inside is ordered from first to last downloaded.

The Waking Halls is an underground hall located in the lower section of Gjalerbron in the Howling Fjord. It is full of slumbering vrykul and the necrolords who are awakening them. Call this function to wait a specified amount of time before running another function with the given parameters. This function is useful when you rely on system messages to trigger your code as (especially with Guild related system messages) the system message is dispatched by the server sometimes before the results have been updated. Waiting to perform the next step of your code becomes easy with this function. <PREFIX>_wait(delay, func [, param [,param [,...]]])

Walt Hayward is one of five Hayward brothers that own and operate the Hayward Fishery in Gilneas. They have operated it for a number of years, but are forced to flee when the Forsaken invasion occurs, coupled with the seismic activity of the Cataclysm. They are successful in gathering their supplies and making repairs to their boats, but nothing is ever heard from them again after their expected departure to the sea. Judging by his long silvery hair, Walt could be the eldest of the five.

The War of the Ancients Trilogy is a trio of books written by author Richard A. Knaak. It details the events of the War of the Ancients (novel account). However, both accounts in the story are slightly different from the previous telling of the war, as is documented in War of the Ancients (WC3 account) and War of the Ancients (WoW account).
War Master Voone is a forest troll mini-boss found in Lower Blackrock Spire.
The Wand of the Whispering Dead has intellect and spirit and increases the healing done by spells.
Wandering Barrens Giraffes are giraffes found in the lower-central Barrens.

The Wandering Protector is an ancient that patrols around the area east of Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale Forest. It is advisible for Horde players to keep an eye out, as the Protector has a habit of showing up in the worst possible situations. A large number of Horde players like to return to Ashenvale at later dates and kill the Protector.

War golems are a kind of armor-based golem that could be seen in cities during the Third War. The more perverse flesh golems are similar in build. In World of Warcraft, the term "war golem" is used to describe variants of stone golem that are a Dark Iron clan invention. The dwarven golem is an advanced variation (though apparently ancient in design). Warcraft III: Reforged makes the animated suits of armor into the stone golems of WoW.
The Wandering Skeleton is a skeleton found at Dalson's Tears in the Western Plaguelands.

The War Room (also spelled war room and also known as the map room) is located inside Stormwind Keep, to the right and southeast of the central throne room from the main hall of the keep. Weapons of war line the walls, everything from blunderbusses to swords to even three cannons. There are areas piled high with books about military strategy and its signature map table at the room's center where Alliance military leaders plan their strategies. It is the location of all the battlemasters, which moved into this room from the throne room in patch 2.0.1. It is also here where players can turn off their experience point gain by paying Behsten. The Wand of the Netherwing is a wand most sought after by dps casters.
The War Rider Bracers were awarded by Captain Nials upon completion of the Alliance quest Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest which starts with the Wanted Board located at Refuge Pointe of Arathi Highlands.

Wanton Hostesses are banshees located in the Guest Chambers in Karazhan. They are disguised as blood elves, but at 50% health they reveal their true appearance, removing all debuffs in the process. Wanton Hosts are the male equivalent.
